description: OFFICIAL SAVINGS scrapers for the payments banks (as many as are actually parseable), registered in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS, each with an offline fixture regression test. Payments banks are SAVINGS-ONLY: adapters must emit only SAVINGS rows and never FD/RD. Unscrapeable banks (esp. Paytm Payments Bank, which is RBI-restricted) are documented BLOCKED block-by-block in ingest.mjs and left rate-less. Depends on FEAT-002 (PAYMENTS_BANK category + banks.ts entries must exist first).
steps: Read the discovery data from the CI diagnose run (dispatched on the payments-bank URLs). Read the run logs to see, per URL: number of tables, table shapes/first rows, bodyPctSamples, rateLinks, and captured networkHits/promising JSON. Command pattern (single shell): gh api "repos/urbdag/psb-deposit-rates/actions/runs/<DIAGNOSE_ID>/logs" > /tmp/l.zip && rm -rf /tmp/ld && mkdir -p /tmp/ld && unzip -o -q /tmp/l.zip -d /tmp/ld && grep -rihE "airtel|ippb|fino|paytm|jio|nsdl|saving|table|DIAGNOSIS|%|networkHit|promising" /tmp/ld | head -200 . If the first diagnose round is inconclusive for a bank, dispatch another diagnose round with alternate URLs (.bank.in variants, dedicated savings/interest-rate pages, PDF rate cards) BEFORE deciding a bank is blocked. Dispatch: gh api -X POST repos/urbdag/psb-deposit-rates/actions/workflows/diagnose.yml/dispatches -f ref="main" -f 'inputs[urls]=<space-separated URLs>'.

For each payments bank with a parseable OFFICIAL savings-rate source, add an adapter in src/ingest/adapters/<id>.ts. Base pattern: subclass TableRateAdapter (src/ingest/adapters/base.ts). CRITICAL savings-only handling: these banks have NO FD/RD. TableAdapterConfig requires fdUrl, and base.fetchRates throws only when BOTH FD and savings yield nothing, publishing a savings-only success otherwise. Point fdUrl at the same savings/interest page (parseFdRd will find no valid FD table and return 0 rows) OR override parseFdRd to return [] so no FD/RD is ever emitted; set deriveRdFromFd:false. Set savingsUrls to the confirmed savings page(s) and renderJs:true if the page is client-rendered. Confirm the adapter returns ONLY SAVINGS rows.

For FLAT single savings rate: base parseSavings/extractSavingsRate returns GENERAL+SENIOR SAVINGS rows at the standard band automatically — reuse as-is. For TIERED-by-balance-slab savings: study bob.ts + extractSlabSavingsRate in base.ts (it picks the 'one step above base' cluster with a MAX_SLAB_STEP guard). If a payments bank's slabs don't fit that heuristic (e.g. two bands within Rs 0-2 lakh with a larger gap), write a bespoke parseSavings override that extracts the per-slab rates and emits one SAVINGS row per balance band with a correct AmountThreshold (minAmount/maxAmount/label), or at minimum the headline/base savings rate as a single SAVINGS row. NEVER mis-tier: only publish a slab rate under the balance band it actually applies to. Keep rates in the sane savings band (~2-7%).

Register each working adapter in scripts/ingest.mjs: add the compiled-path import (e.g. `const { AirtelAdapter } = await import(resolve(root, `${A}/airtel.js`));`) and add `new AirtelAdapter()` to the ADAPTERS array. Follow the existing import+comment style.

For every payments bank that is NOT scrapeable, add a BLOCKED documentation comment block in scripts/ingest.mjs (mirror the SFB/private BLOCKED blocks) stating the bank id, the exact URLs probed, and the concrete diagnose finding (e.g. 'renders 0 tables / rates in image', 'hard render failure', 'RBI-restricted, no active public savings-rate page'). Paytm Payments Bank is RBI-restricted — if it has no current parseable savings-rate page, document it BLOCKED and leave it rate-less; never fabricate.

Add one offline fixture regression test per working adapter in scripts/test-adapters.mjs (mirror the CapitalsfbAdapter/ShivalikAdapter tests). Each test feeds a realistic fixture HTML string (modeled on the diagnose-observed structure) to the adapter's parseSavings (and parseFdRd to assert it yields 0 FD rows), asserting: the correct SAVINGS rate(s) at the right customer/amount band, that NO FD or RD rows are produced, and that a reverted/wrong parse would fail (behavioral, not static). For tiered slabs assert the per-slab AmountThreshold mapping.

Rebuild + offline-verify: `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run typecheck` && `env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run build` && `env -u NODE_OPTIONS node scripts/test-adapters.mjs` (all pass; new fixture tests included). Stage sources + regenerated compiled public/js/** together and commit (e.g. 'feat(payments): OFFICIAL savings scrapers for <banks> + document blocked + offline fixtures'). Push to main.

Dispatch the ingest workflow to publish rates: gh api -X POST repos/urbdag/psb-deposit-rates/actions/workflows/ingest.yml/dispatches -f ref="main". Poll the run; read its logs (same download+unzip+grep one-liner, grepping the bank ids + 'saving|refreshed|fell back|error') to confirm each registered payments bank refreshed SAVINGS. After ingest commits back, `git fetch origin main` and inspect public/data/dataset.json for each payments bank: SAVINGS product, OFFICIAL quality, official-domain source URL, sane rate(s), correct bankId. Confirm the follow-on deploy run concludes success so rates are live.
Record in findings which payments banks published OFFICIAL savings rates vs which stayed BLOCKED and why, plus the dataset.json diff summary and the ingest/deploy run ids.
acceptance_criteria: Each scrapeable payments bank has an adapter that emits ONLY SAVINGS rows (no FD/RD), registered in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS
Each working adapter has an offline fixture test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs that asserts the correct savings rate(s) and that no FD/RD rows are produced, and fails if the parser is reverted
Every non-scrapeable payments bank (incl. Paytm if restricted) is documented BLOCKED with the URLs probed and the concrete diagnose finding, and is left rate-less (no fabricated rates)
env -u NODE_OPTIONS npm run typecheck / build / test-adapters.mjs all pass

A CI ingest run refreshes the registered payments banks' SAVINGS rows and commits back; public/data/dataset.json on origin/main shows, for each published bank, SAVINGS + OFFICIAL + official-domain source + sane rate + matching bankId
The deploy run following the ingest commit concludes success
verification: git fetch origin main && git show origin/main:public/data/dataset.json | grep -iE 'airtel|ippb|fino|jio|nsdl|paytm'
findings:
COMPLETED — Fino PUBLISHED OFFICIAL savings live via CI ingest; 5 payments banks documented BLOCKED. LIVE RESULT: Fino's 1 Dec 2025 PDF rate card parsed to two savings bands: up to & incl. Rs. 1 Lakh = 1.50%, above Rs. 1 Lakh = 4.50% (GENERAL + SENIOR each), source fino.bank.in PDF, OFFICIAL, bankId fino. Two ingest bugs found + fixed along the way: (1) pdf-parse@1.1.1 index.js ran a debug block (guarded by !module.parent, truthy under ESM dynamic import) that read a missing bundled test fixture and threw ENOENT before parsing — fixed by importing pdf-parse/lib/pdf-parse.js directly (src/ingest/pdf.ts); this was the FIRST adapter to exercise the real PDF path so it affected any future PDF adapter too. (2) The real extracted PDF text collapses the whole slab table into one run with each band glued to its rate and a preceding 'Above INR 1,95,000' footnote; rewrote parseSavingsPdf to scan the whole text by rate-% position (label = gap since previous rate), added trailingBandClause to isolate the band adjacent to each rate (ignoring the footnote figure), lowered the plausible-rate floor to 1% (base 1.50% is below 2%), and widened the effective-date regex to accept 'Eff 1 st December 2025'. Ingest run 35428850147 (HEAD bfa3c89) succeeded and committed dataset.json back; a later ingest after the debug-log removal confirms Fino refreshes SAVINGS. BLOCKED (left rate-less, documented in ingest.mjs with URLs + diagnose findings): airtel (Cloudflare challenge shell), ippb (hard render failure; GoI-owned via India Post), nsdlpb (hard render failure), jio (hard render failure), paytm (0 tables, RBI-restricted). typecheck/build (Wrote 60 pages)/test-adapters.mjs all green; offline Fino fixture test models the real PDF text and is a behavioral regression guard.

IMPLEMENTATION (offline verified; CI ingest pending): Added FinoAdapter (src/ingest/adapters/fino.ts) — SAVINGS-ONLY. It overrides fetchRates to fetch Fino's linked PDF rate card (fetchPdfText) and parse tiered savings-by-balance-slab via a PURE parseSavingsPdf(text) that emits one SAVINGS row (GENERAL+SENIOR) per balance band with a correct AmountThreshold; parseFdRd/parsePdfFdRd are overridden to always return [] and deriveRdFromFd:false, so NO FD/RD is ever emitted. parseBalanceBand handles Indian rupee grouping + lakh/crore words + up-to/above qualifiers; a single flat headline rate falls back to one all-balances band. Registered FinoAdapter in scripts/ingest.mjs ADAPTERS under a new 'Payments banks (PAYMENTS_BANK)' section, and added a BLOCKED documentation block for the 5 unscrapeable payments banks (airtel = Cloudflare challenge shell; ippb = hard render failure, GoI-owned; nsdlpb/jio = hard render failure; paytm = 0 tables + RBI-restricted) with URLs probed + diagnose findings. Added a behavioral offline fixture test in scripts/test-adapters.mjs (feeds realistic PDF-extracted text: asserts 3 slabs -> 6 SAVINGS rows with correct per-band AmountThreshold + rate, NO FD/RD, effective date 2025-12-01 parsed, flat-rate fallback, junk->0, and that parseFdRd/parsePdfFdRd always yield 0). typecheck + build (Wrote 60 pages) + test-adapters.mjs all GREEN. NOTE: Fino PDF may 403/rotate at ingest (diagnose could not fetch PDFs); if so, Fino keeps last-known-good and stays effectively rate-less per hard rule — will confirm from the CI ingest run.

PRE-DELEGATION DISCOVERY (4 CI diagnose rounds, see .agents/tasks/task-payments-banks/diagnostics-digest.md): Only FINO is scrapeable — its authoritative savings source is a PDF rate card linked from every fino.bank.in page: https://www.fino.bank.in/files/fino/media/post_attachments/sites/default/files/2025-11/Savings%20Account%20Revised%20Interest%20Rates%20Effective%20from%201st%20Dec%202025.pdf (effective 1 Dec 2025, tiered savings by balance slab). Fino HTML pages render 0 tables (Next.js + reCAPTCHA). AIRTEL (airtelpayments.bank.in): Cloudflare challenge shell, 0 tables -> BLOCKED. IPPB (ippbonline.com / ippb.bank.in / ippb.gov.in): hard render failure -> BLOCKED. NSDL (nsdlpaymentsbank.com + variants): hard render failure -> BLOCKED. JIO (jiopaymentsbank.com + variants): hard render failure -> BLOCKED. PAYTM (paytmbank.com): 0 tables/no rates, RBI-restricted -> BLOCKED.
